title: Speed up a duplicate check
prompt: Return true when any number appears more than once in values. The starter is correct and compares every pair. Rewrite it to read each element about once: the last check counts the reads on 2,000 different numbers.
hints: What does the inner loop search for, and what structure could answer that in one step?
Keep a Set of the numbers seen so far. Before adding a number, ask whether it is already there.
for each value: if seen.has(value) return true, otherwise seen.add(value). Return false at the end.
checkLabels: An empty array has no duplicate.
Two equal numbers are a duplicate.
Do not compare every pair. Read each of the 2,000 numbers only a few times.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Compares every pair, which is correct and far too slow.
Compares only neighbours, which works only when the array is sorted.

feedback: The answers are right and the work is too much. Replace the inner loop with one question to a Set.
